content:
Actor Amanda Seyfried announced to People magazine on Thursday that she and her husband Thomas Sadoski have split, calling it "the best decision for us."

The couple said in a statement to the magazine: "We have been separated for a while now, and it has turned out to be the right choice for us and our family. We will always be there for each other — and we are doing great right now."

Seyfried, who starred in The Housemaid and Mean Girls, and Sadoski, known for the TV series Life in Pieces, met while working together on an off-Broadway play in 2015. They later played a couple in the Shirley MacLaine-led film The Last Word and eloped in March 2017.

According to a January Vogue report, the family has been living on an animal rescue farm run by the couple, with their children attending nearby schools.

The Mamma Mia! lead told the magazine that her husband "sacrificed a lot for me."

She said: "He also understands that the opportunities being given to me right now are just incredible. I say no to a lot of things all the time."

When she attended the Toronto International Film Festival on Sunday for the screening of her new film The Life and Deaths of Wilson Shedd, she did not appear to be wearing her wedding ring.
